senses.gloss:
mfn. adj. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Maiden, virgin.
2 Juvenile.
3 Soft, tender.
f. (-री)
One of the seven Mātṛs, the divine mothers or personified energies of the gods; the energy or Śakti of KUMĀRA or KĀRTTIKEYA.
n. (-रं)
1 Youth, childhood, from birth to the age of five.
2 Maidenhood to the age of sixteen.
E.
कुमार a youth, and अञ् aff.; or कुमार the deity KĀRTTIKEYA, अण् and ङीष् affixes.

m. (-दः)
The month Kartik, (Oct.-Nov.)
f. (-दी)
1 Moonlight.
2 A festival.
3 A festival in honour of KĀRTTIKEYA, held on the full moon of the month Kartik.
4 Day of full moon in the month Aśvin.
5 The same in the month Kartik.
E.
कुमुद a white lotus, अण् and ङीष् affixes, कौमुदी moonlight, equally white or brilliant; the other senses come from this.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to a water lily, abounding with them, &c. कुमुद, and ठञ् aff.

f. (-का)
A companion and confidant of DURGĀ.

mn. (-रः-रं)
Day of full moon in the month of Aśvin.
E.
कौमुदी a festival, and चार what proceeds.

m. (-तिः)
The moon.
E.
कौमुदी moonlight, and पति lord.

m. (-क्षः)
the stick or stand of a lamp.
E.
कौमुदी here light in general, and वृक्ष a tree.

f. (-की)
The club or mace of KṚṢṆA.
E.
कुमुदक what gives the earth pleasure, here said to be VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA, affixes अण् and ङीष्; also कौमुदी.
